description: A one-permit semaphore: t.a takes it at 0 and releases it at 50. t.b (from 10) waits under time::timeout with 100 ns: the timeout's Sleep registers its timer on the first poll (deadline 110), the release at 50 hands t.b the permit, the acquire completes first, and dropping the timeout cancels the timer (timer.cancelled, no fire at 110). t.b then sleeps past 110 to show no stray wake.
